subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress sub-agent announce

question: Should deterministic suppression ship as a narrow skip boolean or as one typed completion destination shared with parent-routing work?
rationale: The missing capability is source-proven, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/tool surface and implementation evidence cannot choose the permanent public orchestration contract.

options.title: Unified destination policy
options.body: Expose channel, parent, and skip as one typed policy and thread it through every spawn runtime and completion lifecycle path.

options.title: Narrow skip option
options.body: Add only deterministic suppression now while leaving routing and channel granularity to separate future surfaces.

options.title: Keep token convention
options.body: Decline new public surface and retain exact model-output tokens as the only supported suppression mechanism.

recommendation.title: Unified destination policy
recommendation.body: Expose channel, parent, and skip as one typed policy and thread it through every spawn runtime and completion lifecycle path.

likelyOwner.reason: The initial spawn implementation and central announce-delivery refactor both trace to this owner, making them the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
